task.title: Empty / loading / pending / blocked state grammar

evidence.text: RECON ONLY — claim released with a clean tree, no code written. Recorded so the next agent starts from the inventory rather than re-deriving it. CARRIED ALREADY (src/ui/primitives.tsx): PendingBadge, ReadinessIndicator, BlockedOverlay all exist; ProvenanceBorder too. The nine-id readiness LAW is landed and typed in src/ui/bridgeReadiness.ts (BridgeReadinessId, BRIDGE_READINESS_IDS, readinessSeverity, readinessTier, needsWrappingShell, classifyReadiness) and re-declared verbatim as CHROME-CONTRACT §6, machine-checked by src/chromeContract.test.ts. REAL GAPS: (1) EmptyState — absent entirely; (2) LoadingPulse — absent entirely, and it carries a real law worth honouring, Foundation Principle 2: when the bridge is available the pulse advances with the profile tick and there is NO local timer, falling back to a local 200ms timer ONLY under bridge_unavailable (note the heartbeat pulses at 1Hz — see the 28.T28.4 finding about per-tick work); (3) the three existing primitives are UNTYPED against the taxonomy — PendingBadge takes  not BridgeReadinessId, ReadinessIndicator takes a loose three-value state, BlockedOverlay takes a bare reason string, and NONE of them surface ownerTrack, which the spec makes the point of the tooltip ('the user can identify which track owns the missing field'); (4) per-id semantic colour (readiness.id.<id>) is not tokenised — the spec is explicit that it must be per-id, not generic amber. AUTHORITIES FOR THE BUILD, both located: ownerTrack + per-id meaning live in the readinessTaxonomy array of Body/M/epi-theia/extensions/contracts/07-t0-extension-contract-preflight.json (frozen tree — do NOT import across the boundary; the carrier already owns a verbatim re-declaration of this taxonomy by design in CHROME-CONTRACT §6, so extending src/ui/bridgeReadiness.ts with ownerTrack/meaning continues that established pattern rather than inventing law), and src/engine/integratedReadiness.ts already carries per-FIELD ownerTrack strings as a precedent for the shape. VERIFY LINE demands 9 ids x 5 primitives = 45 cases plus a reason-routing test for ownerTrack, a deep-link test (s5_review_blocked opens the OmniPanel Review fold — that fold is live as ReviewBlocksPane), and a consume-not-fork lint; track 30 is class UF so it also needs real-surface proof. Depends on 30.T30.5 (done, 5a8ff33f) whose accessibility contract the new primitives must satisfy — EmptyState/LoadingPulse need aria text equivalents and LoadingPulse is CONTINUOUS motion, so under prefers-reduced-motion it must stop entirely per reducedMotionDurationMs().

CORRECTION to the previous entry: one phrase was eaten by shell backtick substitution and read "PendingBadge takes  not BridgeReadinessId". It should read: PendingBadge takes a plain (id: string) parameter, NOT the typed BridgeReadinessId from src/ui/bridgeReadiness.ts. Everything else in that entry stands.

task.carrier: CARRIER: the ENTIRE design-token bundle + 15-primitive shelf + consumption lint, re-homed to CSS vars/TS for React/Tauri. Token law = 30.8 derivation-backed tiers; motion = ratified DR-UI-4 (400/240/320). DR-WC-DL-1 (family palette) still open — re-decide for carrier. §2 track 30.
